title.en: Fable 30 — The Miser and His Gold

sentences.en: A miser buried his gold under a stone.
Every day he went to look at it.
One day, he found the hole empty.

sentences.ar: جاره قال له: حط حجر مكانه.
sentences.en: His neighbour said to him: put a stone in its place.
You never used the gold anyway.

sentences.ar: المال اللي ما بينصرف زي الحجر.
sentences.en: Money that is never spent is like a stone.
